name: Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive World Legend Mastercard®

welcome_offer.description: Limited-time offer: earn 125,000 American Airlines AAdvantage bonus miles after $15,000 in purchases in the first 5 months of account opening.
notes: 2026-09-29 official Citi product page (rendered) shows "Limited time offer: Earn 125,000 AAdvantage bonus miles after $15,000 in purchases in the first 5 months", $695 annual fee, World Legend Mastercard. No end date published.
Supersedes both the July 100k/$10k elevated listing and the August 70k/$7k listing.
source_conflicts: Older secondary coverage (DoC July 2026: 100k/$10k; TPG Aug 2026: 70k/$7k) no longer matches the official Citi page.

earning_rates.notes: Earn 4 AAdvantage miles per $1 on American Airlines purchases
Earn 12 AAdvantage miles per $1 on eligible AAdvantage Hotels and AAdvantage Cars bookings.
Earn 1 AAdvantage mile per $1 on all other purchases

lounge_access.name: Admirals Club®
lounge_access.notes: Primary cardmember and up to 2 guests; access to 100+ Admirals Club® and partner lounges worldwide (valued up to $850)

other_benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit
other_benefits.description: Up to $120 every 5 years toward Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee

other_benefits.name: Companion Certificate
other_benefits.description: Annual companion certificate (requires $4,000 spend in anniversary year)

other_benefits.name: 10% AAdvantage Miles Redemption Bonus
other_benefits.description: 10% back on AAdvantage miles redeemed for award flights

other_benefits.name: First Bag Free
other_benefits.description: First checked bag free for cardholder and up to 8 companions on domestic AA flights booked with the card

other_benefits.name: Priority Boarding
other_benefits.description: Priority boarding on American Airlines flights

other_benefits.name: American Airlines Vacations Credit
other_benefits.description: Up to $500 each calendar year on eligible American Airlines Vacations packages/experiences: up to $250 Jan-Jun and up to $250 Jul-Dec.

other_benefits.name: Inflight and Admirals Club Statement Credit
other_benefits.description: Up to $100 back each calendar year on inflight and eligible Admirals Club purchases.

other_benefits.name: Omni Hotels & Resorts Champion Status
other_benefits.description: Complimentary Omni Champion Status; enrollment required.

other_benefits.name: Omni Free Night Award
other_benefits.description: Once per calendar year, earn an Omni Free Night Award after a stay of 2+ consecutive nights booked directly on omnihotels.com; Champion Status enrollment required.

other_benefits.name: Expanded Loyalty Point Bonuses
other_benefits.description: Earn a 10,000 Loyalty Point bonus after reaching 50,000, 90,000, 165,000 and 240,000 Loyalty Points in the same status qualification year (up to 40,000).

sources.notes: Official Citi page checked 2026-09-29: 125,000 miles after $15,000/5 months (limited time), $695 fee, World Legend, $500 AA Vacations, $100 inflight/Admirals, $180 Lyft, $120 Avis/Budget, $120 GE/TSA credits.
Secondary: 2026-08 card refresh coverage ($695 fee, World Legend, new credits).
Secondary confirmation of 2026-08-23 refresh details and transition timing.

recurring_credits.name: Avis / Budget Car Rental Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $120 in statement credits on eligible prepaid Avis and Budget car rentals booked directly on avis.com or budget.com.

recurring_credits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $120 statement credit for Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee, every 4 years.

recurring_credits.name: Lyft Credit
recurring_credits.description: $15 Lyft credit after 3 eligible rides in a calendar month (up to $180/year).

recurring_credits.name: American Airlines Vacations Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $500/calendar year in statement credits on eligible AA Vacations packages/experiences: up to $250 Jan-Jun and up to $250 Jul-Dec.

recurring_credits.name: Inflight and Admirals Club Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $100/calendar year in statement credits on inflight and eligible Admirals Club purchases.
